sections.title: Advanced Poetry Writing Workshop
sections.description: This workshop is suitable for students with some prior experience in poetry who are interested in pushing their practice and learning new poetic forms, such as long poems, serial poems, cross-genre work, multimedia poetry, or poetry informed by critical research. Students will write in response to weekly creative prompts, will read and discuss work by a number of different poets, and will workshop each other's writing throughout the semester before producing a final portfolio of writing.
